caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, full-length dress that appears to be from the late 19th century. The dress is rendered in soft beige or ivory tones, giving it an elegant and classic appearance. It features a high collar, long fitted sleeves with decorative cuffs, and a closely-fitted bodice with a visible seam or button detail down the center front. The skirt is full and elaborately draped, with layers of fabric gathered and gently cascading toward the floor. Along the right side of the dress, starting from the upper bodice and extending diagonally across the front of the skirt, there is a garland composed of realistic red and pale yellow flowers with green leaves. The hem of the skirt is finished with a wide band of gathered or pleated fabric, adding texture and volume. The entire composition is set against a plain, light background. The dress is depicted without a body or head, serving as a focused study on the costume itself.
title: Dress
